title.zh-TW: 新用戶註冊可得 100 點，可折抵課程
title.en: New users get 100 points on sign-up, usable toward courses

text.zh-TW: 新用戶限定，使用邀請碼 5JET5H 註冊；點數折抵有上限，詳見注意事項。取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: New users only; sign up with invite code 5JET5H. Point use is capped; see notes. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（邀請碼 5JET5H 已包含在連結中，會轉到 PressPlay Academy 的登入／註冊頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (invite code 5JET5H is already in it; it leads to the PressPlay Academy log-in / sign-up page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示註冊 PressPlay Academy 帳號；若註冊頁有欄位要求輸入邀請碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入 5JET5H。
steps.en: Register a PressPlay Academy account as the page asks; if a field asks for an invite code, enter 5JET5H exactly as shown, with capitalization.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊後確認帳號是否收到分享文案所說的 100 點；是否入帳、有效期限與使用規則，以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After signing up, check whether the 100 points from the share text were credited; crediting, validity and rules follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 購買課程時使用點數折抵；單筆購買最高折抵 10%（訂閱首月最高 20%），且不可與優惠券同時使用。
steps.en: Use points to discount a course purchase; the cap is 10% of one purchase (20% of a subscription's first month), and points cannot be used together with coupons.

intro.zh-TW: PressPlay Academy 線上學習平台；依分享文案，新用戶用邀請碼 5JET5H 註冊可得 100 點。
intro.en: Per the share text, new users who sign up with code 5JET5H get 100 points for courses.

description.zh-TW:
PressPlay Academy（簡稱 PPA）是台灣的線上學習平台，提供影音、音訊與文字課程，可單次購買或訂閱，有網站與手機 App。本頁的邀請連結已包含邀請碼 5JET5H；若註冊或登入頁面有欄位要求輸入邀請碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。

依平台提供的分享文案，新用戶使用邀請碼註冊可得 100 點，點數可用於課程折抵；折抵上限、不可與優惠券同時使用等規則，以 PressPlay Academy 官方的點數規則為準。分享文案也提到 iPhone17 抽獎活動，但本站沒有找到官方頁面把它和邀請點數連在一起，所以不列為優惠。實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
PressPlay Academy (PPA) is an online-learning platform in Taiwan that sells video, audio and text courses by single purchase or subscription, with a website and a mobile app. The referral link on this page already contains invite code 5JET5H; if the sign-up or log-in page has a field for an invite code, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

According to the platform's share text, new users who sign up with the invite code get 100 points that can discount courses. The point caps and the rule against using points together with coupons follow PressPlay Academy's official point rules. The share text also mentions an iPhone 17 lottery, but no official page was found that links it to invitation points, so it is not listed as a benefit. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
分享文案寫「新用戶限定」：使用邀請碼 5JET5H 註冊可立即得 100 點，可享課程折抵，並須遵守相關活動條款。連結是 pressplay.cc 的會員頁網址（/member/checkin?share=5JET5H），2026-10-24 開啟時會轉到登入／註冊頁，邀請碼保留在網址的 next_url 參數中；該頁只顯示通用的註冊優惠文字，沒有顯示 100 點。本站沒有找到官方頁面說明邀請碼贈點，也沒有找到對應的活動條款，所以 100 點取自分享文案；邀請碼在註冊時是否被接受、點數是否入帳，本站沒有實際測試。

點數規則（取自 PressPlay Academy 官方客服中心「點數規則說明」，託管在共用服務 intercom.help/pressplay-academy，因此未列入官方網域；2026-10-24 查閱）：1 點相當於 NT$1，可折抵平台上知識內容的購買；單筆購買最高折抵 10%，訂閱首月最高折抵 20%（活動另有規定）；不可與優惠券、組合優惠或試用同時使用，不可轉讓。因此 100 點通常無法全額折抵小額訂單。這筆贈點的有效期限未知；分享文案沒有提供邀請活動的期間，本站未設定到期日。

分享文案另提到 iPhone17 抽獎活動。官方有 2026 年的抽獎活動辦法（自 2026-05-04 起，限台灣會員，至獎項抽完為止），辦法列出的點數來源沒有提到邀請點數，所以本站不把抽獎列為優惠；活動隨時可能結束，請以官方活動辦法為準。

分享文案沒有說明邀請人是否也有回饋。依官方服務條款與隱私權政策，未成年人須經法定代理人同意或審閱；App Store 的年齡分級為 16+。App 內有付費項目（例如代幣），邀請優惠不是購買或儲值的理由。
notes.en:
The share text says “new users only”: signing up with invite code 5JET5H gives 100 points right away that can discount courses, subject to the relevant campaign terms. The link is a member page address on pressplay.cc (/member/checkin?share=5JET5H); when opened on 2026-10-24 it redirected to the log-in / sign-up page, with the code kept in the next_url parameter of the address, and that page showed only a generic sign-up promotion, not the 100 points. No official page describing a code-based point grant was found, and no matching campaign terms were found, so the 100 points come from the share text. Whether the code is accepted at sign-up and the points are credited was not tested.

Point rules (from the official PressPlay Academy help center article “點數規則說明”, hosted on the shared service intercom.help/pressplay-academy and therefore not listed as an official domain; read 2026-10-24): 1 point equals NT$1 and can discount purchases of knowledge content on the platform; the cap is 10% of a single purchase and 20% of the first month of a subscription (events may differ); points cannot be used together with coupons, bundles or trials, and cannot be transferred. So 100 points will not normally cover a small order in full. The validity of this grant is unknown; the share text gives no campaign period, so no expiry date is set here.

The share text also mentions an iPhone 17 lottery. An official 2026 lottery campaign exists for Taiwan members from 2026-05-04 until the prizes are drawn out; the ways to earn points that its rules list do not mention invitation points, so the lottery is not listed as a benefit here. It may close at any time, so follow the official campaign rules.

The share text does not say whether the referrer also gets a reward. Under the official terms of service and privacy policy, a minor needs the consent or review of a legal guardian, and the App Store age rating is 16+. The app sells paid items such as tokens; the invite offer is not a reason to buy or top up.

q.zh-TW: PressPlay Academy 的邀請碼 5JET5H 要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter PressPlay Academy invite code 5JET5H?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼 5JET5H 已包含在本頁的邀請連結中，開啟後轉到的登入頁網址仍保留它，請從「立即註冊」進入即可。本站沒有找到官方說明手動輸入邀請碼的欄位；若註冊頁有欄位要求輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。
a.en: Invite code 5JET5H is already part of the referral link on this page, and the log-in page it opens to still carries it in its address, so just start from “Sign up”. No official page describing a manual entry field was found; if the sign-up page has a field for an invite code, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 分享文案所說的 100 點可以折抵多少？
q.en: How much can the 100 points from the share text take off a purchase?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案，新用戶使用邀請碼註冊可得 100 點。依官方點數規則，1 點相當於 NT$1，但單筆購買最高折抵 10%（訂閱首月最高 20%，活動另有規定），不可與優惠券、組合優惠或試用同時使用，也不可轉讓，所以 100 點通常無法全額折抵小額訂單。本站沒有在官方頁面找到邀請贈點的說明，是否入帳與有效期限以官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the share text, new users who sign up with the invite code get 100 points. Under the official point rules, 1 point equals NT$1, but points cover at most 10% of a single purchase (20% of the first month of a subscription; events may differ). They cannot be used together with coupons, bundles or trials, and cannot be transferred, so 100 points will not normally cover a small order in full. No official page describing the invitation grant was found, so crediting and validity follow the official announcements.
